title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1562: Dont come! ill bite! (3)

section.p: He Tu and Dummy said nothing and turned to face the other pavilion Invincibles instead. As for the minor race Invincibles, they scattered without any hesitation.

They never wanted to fight in the first place. They had only attacked in earnest after Wisdom King’s arrival. Now that Wisdom King had left, they naturally wouldn’t have the courage to stay and fight. This was especially true since Su Yu had gained the assistance of three powerful death sovereigns.

Wisdom King frowned as he saw that. Sure enough, the minor races were unreliable. He was not fleeing. He was merely trying to lure the death sovereigns away. He knew the weakness of death spirits. Due to their lack of intelligence, they could easily be provoked. Annoyingly, He Tu seemed smarter than the other death spirits. He also seemed quite close to Su Yu.

Nevertheless, the minor race Invincibles shouldn’t have fled so readily. Wisdom King felt very helpless. Sure enough, worthless comrades were more terrifying than powerful opponents. If these Invincibles were obedient enough, they could probably deal with even ten death sovereigns without much trouble.
He sighed and decided to put the matter behind him for now.
Whatever.

He should only rely on himself, not the minor race Invincibles. It wasn’t a bad thing that these death sovereigns were out. With this, Su Yu’s trump card had been exposed. He returned and threw a punch at He Tu, pushing He Tu multiple steps back. Dummy reacted with a punch, while He Tu shot forward again right after stopping.
As for Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng, they started attacking the three pavilion Invincibles alongside Xing Yue.
While charging, Su Yu sent a voice transmission, “Lord, can you keep the death sovereigns down there under control? Things might grow troublesome if they come here as well.”
That would truly expose his trump card and ruin his plan.
“It’s fine. They can stay patient for now, but living beings are too attractive for death spirits. Their patience won’t last long.”
Hearing that, Su Yu knew what to do.

“Lord, feign an injury and leave first. Shout that you’re getting help before leaving. These people won’t give us the opportunity to recruit help. I’ll jump into the tunnel soon after. They will definitely give chase.”
“Sure.”
Xing Yue agreed readily. She was happy not using her brain. That way, she only needed to focus on fighting instead of worrying about anything else.

Having made up his mind, Su Yu started gathering strength. But as he did that, Xing Yue was weakened slightly. Meanwhile, Wisdom King was able to speak even when dealing with two death sovereigns. He said, “Kill that death spirit! When he gathers strength, she will weaken!”
Immediately after, the North Chamber head swung his sword at Xing Yue. He could sense Xing Yue’s weakness as well. Su Yu seemed to be drawing his strength from her!

With a snort, Su Yu worked with Wan Tiansheng and continued attacking the other two heads. Instead of helping Xing Yue, he gnashed his teeth and said, “Lord, please resist for a bit. After killing these two, we’ll help you!”
Xing Yue said nothing. She was forced to retreat repeatedly under the attacks of the North Chamber head.

Wisdom King continued facing Dummy and He Tu while focusing on the death tunnel. He noted that no new death spirit was approaching, so he became certain that there were no additional death sovereigns hiding down there.
He was relieved at that discovery.
Immediately upon making that confirmation, he sent a massive palm attack out. He was finally using his real strength. With one strike, he sent both Dummy and He Tu flying.
He Tu sighed, “The dead…are ultimately incomparable to the living.”
He was much stronger than Wisdom King back when he was alive. Now that he was dead, he had grown much weaker.
Wisdom King said, “Only the losers will die while the survivors are the winners. It is only natural that the winners are stronger.”
He followed with another palm attack, further pushing his two opponents back. On the other hand, Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng were pushing their two opponents back as well.
Wisdom King ordered coldly, “Everyone else, time for you to act. You might be able to escape today, but can you escape forever?”

There were so many Invincibles in the area. What were they doing? Su Yu and Wan Tiansheng continued attacking madly, as though they couldn’t hear Wisdom King’s words. They even ignored their injuries as they focused on only attacking the two heads.
Meanwhile, things weren’t looking very good for Xing Yue. Suddenly, her opponent stabbed through her throat with a sword. A large amount of death qi leaked out.
She roared furiously, but before she could go wild, she recalled Su Yu’s words. Thus, she shouted, “Bastard! Just you wait! I’ll call my friends over to kill you together!”
Then, she turned into a clump of death qi before shooting into the death tunnel.
Su Yu’s face fell as he yelled in panic, “Don’t go!”
He Tu yelled as well, “Su Yu, we can’t fight for long! Go back down! We will invite our friends over! You didn’t tell us earlier that there are so many experts waiting here!”
Su Yu yelled in desperation, “Wait! Just wait a little bit longer, Lord He Tu…”
Then, he hurriedly retreated toward the tunnel with Wan Tiansheng in tow. At the same time, the minor race Invincibles had finally gained the courage to rejoin the fight.
Noticing their approach, Su Yu roared, “You dare? There are hundreds of death sovereigns down there! If you—”

Just then, he looked at He Tu and Dummy, who were losing against Wisdom King. He gnashed his teeth in indignation and roared, “I’ll retreat first! Lords, please last a little bit longer! We have hundreds of death sovereigns waiting down there!”
He had barely finished his words when He Tu was sent flying over by a massive explosion. Su Yu hurriedly dragged Wan Tiansheng into the tunnel in panic.

It was time to run. He Tu and Dummy had failed to stop Wisdom King. With He Tu gone, Wisdom King focused his attack on Dummy. He might be stronger, but it also wasn’t so easy for him to kill his two opponents. Noticing that Su Yu had fled, both He Tu and Dummy transformed into death qi before vanishing into the tunnel as well.
After entering the tunnel, Su Yu started shutting the tunnel in panic.
His roars could be heard from the outside, “If you dare to come, you’ll die! You’ll definitely die!”

The tunnel started shrinking. Beside him, Wan Tiansheng was sweating madly. Earlier, he had thought that Su Yu was bluffing to scare Wisdom King and the others. But after entering the tunnel with Su Yu…
He had been sweating without stopping.

Wan Tiansheng felt like he was already dead. Why? Because he was surrounded by death sovereigns. All of them were staring at him with their red, glowing eyes. It felt as though they were all thinking of the best way to eat him. He was so nervous it was as though his heart was going to jump out of his throat.
So Su Yu was serious when he said that there were many death sovereigns down here. This manner of baiting was enough to shock even Wan Tiansheng.

At the same time, Xing Yue sent a voice transmission to all the death sovereigns, “Wait. A bigger fish is coming. It’s Wisdom King of the immortal race, a ninth-degree Eternal from the firs epoch. He will be the best main course.”
The death sovereigns were starting to lose patience.
They wanted to rush out.

However, Xing Yue was persuading them to stop. She continued, “Just wait a bit longer. He will come. That will make it easier for us. He won’t be able to leave after coming. There are Daofuses up there. It’s better for us to deal with him here.”
At that, the death sovereigns forced themselves to stay patient. One of them looked at Wan Tiansheng and asked, “Do we eat this?”
“This guy…is too weak. We’ll decide after killing Wisdom King.”
“Fine. We wait. Only a bit longer. I can’t wait much longer.”
“Same.”

The death sovereigns waited longingly for Wisdom King to arrive. As for Su Yu, he was sweating as well. If the Wisdom King decided to stay up there, both him and Old Wan would be in trouble. Could Xing Yue and He Tu keep the death sovereigns under control?
This was so scary. There were so many of them. Sure, he was already aware of this. But he still couldn’t help feeling nervous when so many death sovereigns were staring at him.
Above.
The tunnel continued shrinking.
Wisdom King frowned. Should he go down? It would be quite dangerous to go.

But soon, his eyes turned sharp as he said, “We go together. Don’t worry. There are only a few death sovereigns down there. We can easily return through the tunnel of an ancient city when we’re done. We will leave right after killing Su Yu. It won’t be dangerous.”
“This…”
The Invincibles seemed unwilling. It was simply too risky to enter the Death Realm.
Wisdom King’s voice turned cold as he said, “Stop wasting time. Do you want your race to go extinct? I am going with you. What are you worried about?”
The Invincibles continued hesitating.
This was truly too dangerous. What if they couldn’t return after entering? What if there were really many death sovereigns waiting down there?
“Su Yu said that there are hundreds of death sovereigns down there…”
In truth, not even these Invincibles believed that.

Wisdom King snorted, “What nonsense is this? If there are really so many death sovereigns down there, he could have released them to kill us all instead. Why did he flee instead? Remember your previous participation. Do you think someone like Su Yu will let that slide in the future?”
Some of them started sighing helplessly. Seeing that the tunnel was about to shut fully, Wisdom King raised his aura and shouted, “Enter! Refuse and meet your retribution after this battle.”

After saying that, he took the lead and rushed into the tunnel. After a slight hesitation, the other Invincibles followed him into the tunnel as well. They felt terrible. But they had no choice but to do this.
In the blink of an eye, Wisdom King, the three pavilion heads, and the fourteen minor race Invincibles went through the tunnel. What else could they do but follow Su Yu into the Death Realm?
Wisdom King wasn’t too worried. He was confident in his own strength. Hundreds of death sovereigns? What a joke. Only a fool would believe that.
